nativeOfflinePlatformTriage.conclusion: Offline ended teardown ownership corrected independently. Minimal native WebKit output contains a zero quantum followed by samples exactly 128 frames behind, consistent with stalled source progress; copied buffers, explicit stereo gain, and immediate output snapshots did not eliminate corruption. No increased tolerance or silent browser exclusions applied.

The reproduced quantum-aligned pause is consistent with such a native path. This does not establish the exact internal cause or source revision of the tested Playwright binary.
